title: Producers can now vibe code their own music production tools using Google Flow Music.
excerpt: Every artist, producer, and songwriter works differently. To match those individual creative workflows, Spaces in Google Flow Music lets creators build custom instruments or effects using natural language — no coding experience required.Now, we’re making it easy to bring these capabilities directly into professional setups. Producers can now export their custom Spaces as VST3/AU plugins, to run inside their Digital Audio Workstations (DAWs). Simply put, this means producers can easily build things tailored to their processes and styles within their familiar production workflows.Here’s an example from producer Khris Riddick-Tynes. He created a plugin called “No Chaser,” which helps make sure his instrumentals and vocals are sharp and studio-quality, no matter where they were recorded.
content_html:
Every artist, producer, and songwriter works differently. To match those individual creative workflows, Spaces in Google Flow Music lets creators build custom instruments or effects using natural language — no coding experience required.

Now, we’re making it easy to bring these capabilities directly into professional setups. Producers can now export their custom Spaces as VST3/AU plugins, to run inside their Digital Audio Workstations (DAWs). Simply put, this means producers can easily build things tailored to their processes and styles within their familiar production workflows.

Here’s an example from producer Khris Riddick-Tynes. He created a plugin called “No Chaser,” which helps make sure his instrumentals and vocals are sharp and studio-quality, no matter where they were recorded.
